layer_numbering: Phase 4: L = 0..11 input of block L (= logit-lens layer L), 12 = input of ln_f
injection: alpha * c_L * s added at the last real token at every L in l*+1..12; s read at the input of block l* (nothing added there)

rules.removes: test gap <= 0.5 * G_s and acc(none) drop <= 0.02
rules.signal_not_noise: random-control fraction removed < 0.5 * fraction removed by s
rules.alpha_choice: lowest dev gap among alphas with dev acc(none) drop <= 0.02 (counts); ties -> smaller; none -> smallest

dev_set.opposite_version: opposite name inserted at a sentence boundary as make_data.py (insert_name, same allowed positions)

l9_const.chosen_reason: lowest dev gap among 5 alphas with dev acc(none) drop <= 0.02

l3_const.chosen_reason: lowest dev gap among 4 alphas with dev acc(none) drop <= 0.02

l6_const.chosen_reason: lowest dev gap among 3 alphas with dev acc(none) drop <= 0.02

l10_const.chosen_reason: lowest dev gap among 5 alphas with dev acc(none) drop <= 0.02

l11_const.chosen_reason: lowest dev gap among 5 alphas with dev acc(none) drop <= 0.02

l9_decay.chosen_reason: lowest dev gap among 5 alphas with dev acc(none) drop <= 0.02

random_control.direction: per review a unit Gaussian direction (torch.Generator seed 6006 + 10 * seed; dev set + 1), scaled to |s| of the same forward pass; same direction for every version of a review and every layer

l9_const.chosen_reason: the shortcut model's chosen alpha (same seed), not chosen on this model
